instruction: Use ANSYS Mechanical APDL in GUI (interactive graphical) mode to build and solve a 3D solid cantilever beam model. Physical problem: A 3D solid cantilever beam is subjected to a concentrated force at the free end. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system. - The beam length is along the X direction. - The beam height is along the Y direction. - The beam width is along the Z direction. - The beam occupies: - 0 ≤ X ≤ 100 mm - 0 ≤ Y ≤ 10 mm - 0 ≤ Z ≤ 10 mm - The fixed end is the face at X = 0. - The free end is the face at X = 100. - The force application point is the top midpoint of the free end: - X = 100 mm - Y = 10 mm - Z = 5 mm Model parameters: - Beam cross section: 10 mm × 10 mm - Beam length: 100 mm - Material: linear elastic steel - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa - Poisson's ratio ν = 0.3 - Element type: SOLID185 - Mesh: global element size 5 mm Boundary conditions and load: - Fully constrain all translational degrees of freedom on the fixed face X = 0. - Apply a concentrated force of 100 N in the negative global Y direction at the top midpoint of the free end, located at (100, 10, 5) mm. Analysis type: - Static structural analysis. Save requirements: - Use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop as the ANSYS working directory. - Save the database file as: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\apdl_solid_beam.db - Save the structural result file as: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\apdl_solid_beam.rst Run the solver to completion and ensure a result file is generated. You must complete all operations interactively through the ANSYS graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
